info.name: player-service
info.description: player-service (Team 19, Topic 3 — Student ID, Please): CRUD, progression and the error contract, as of Lab 5 (`decision.evaluated` and `session.closed` arrive from the Message Broker; the REST stand-in is local only, see its folder; a closed shift is credited through the two-phase commit, whose participant routes are local only too, see that folder). Run the folders top to bottom, or use the Collection Runner: later requests use {{playerId}} and {{decisionPlayerId}} captured on the way. Calls go through the API Gateway (`baseUrl` http://localhost:8080) with the API key from the `apiKey` variable as `Authorization: Bearer` (one of the keys in GATEWAY_API_KEYS; never stored here). Every request sends its own `X-Request-Id` and checks that it comes back, and every error is checked for the `{error, message}` shape. Instance status, metrics and the two-phase commit routes need `playerInstanceUrl` (see those folders). `Get Player By Id` keeps a saved example of `503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`, the answer while the replicated database fails over (Lab 5); it is never run.

item.name: Two-Phase Commit Participant (direct, local only)
item.description: Lab 5, Grade 8: closing a shift credits it to every moderator of the shift inside a two-phase commit coordinated by the Message Broker (CPR `contracts/two-phase.md`). The broker calls `POST /internal/two-phase/{transactionId}/prepare | commit | abort` over gRPC; on HTTP they are reachable only on the Compose network, and the Gateway routes no `/internal` path. These requests play the coordinator by hand: a YES vote, phase 2 repeated, a rollback, presumed abort, a NO vote and the validation. Set `playerInstanceUrl` (e.g. `http://player-service:8081` for newman on the Compose network); empty, the whole folder is skipped. The shift itself, through the Gateway and the broker, is in the `server-moderation-session-service` collection.
